needs_human.note: A touch or mouse browse point is cleared by Enter on the focused ruler, because activate() maps every seek to the 'seek' event. I3's touch list names only tapping a tile or the card. The spec does not say what Enter does to a point that touch set.; When the source changes, the point takes the new source's lifetime. For example, a mouse hover over the ruler after arrow keys turns a keyboard point into a mouse point that survives focus leaving. The spec gives no rule for this; r8 noted it and it is still open.
